pool.text: Personnel from Fortress Louisbourg founded a settlement named Port La Joye in Charlottetown.
A British fleet took control of the Port La Joye settlement and the island.
Captain Samuel Holland selected Charlottetown as the site for Queens County seat.
Massachusetts-based privateers ransacked the new capital during the American Revolution.
The local British garrison constructed a harbour defence called Fort Edward in Charlottetown.
Government House was constructed at Fanning Bank as the governor's residence.
Charlottetown was officially incorporated as a city in the province.
Charlottetown hosted the famous conference discussing proposed Maritime Union.
Prince Edward Island officially entered Confederation on the first of July.
The Prince Edward Island Railway opened its main line to Summerside.
The Charlottetown Hospital opened as the first health care facility.
The Maritime Christian College was founded to train preachers in the region.
The Confederation Centre of the Arts opened as a gift to residents.
The city became home to the amalgamated University of Prince Edward Island.
The Queen Elizabeth Hospital opened to serve the local population.
The Department of Veterans Affairs moved its national headquarters to Charlottetown.
The Atlantic Veterinary College opened, expanding the university further.
CN Rail abandoned provincial rail service, transforming eastern waterfront lands.
Charlottetown amalgamated with Parkdale and several incorporated surrounding communities.
A new cruise ship terminal opened to attract more maritime vessels.
